description: Source file for Idle Air Control (IAC) valve management running in its own thread, including PID control, hardware initialization, and control logic for idle regulation in an engine management system.

classes.name: SimplePwm
classes.description: Class managing PWM output for idle solenoid.

classes.name: StepperMotor
classes.description: Class controlling stepper motor for IAC.

methods.name: showIdleInfo
methods.description: Displays current idle mode and hardware configuration details.

methods.name: applyIACposition
methods.description: Sets the IAC valve position using either stepper or PWM based on configuration.

methods.name: manualIdleController
methods.description: Calculates idle valve position manually based on CLT correction.

methods.name: automaticIdleController
methods.description: Calculates idle valve position automatically using PID control, with clustering around target RPM.

methods.name: ivThread
methods.description: Main thread function controlling idle regulation loop, running PID updates and hardware commands.

methods.name: initIdleHardware
methods.description: Initializes idle hardware (stepper or PWM) based on configuration.

methods.name: startIdleThread
methods.description: Starts the idle control thread and sets up related hardware and console commands.
